purpose: Every French action/handler parameter renamed to English, keyed by the action name as it is written in wiki syntax. This file is the input to the later migration that rewrites {{action param="..."}} in stored page bodies -- that migration is deliberately NOT part of ticket 22 (decided 2026-07-31: documented breaking changes now, migration magic later).
actionNamesHereAreTheOLDones: Ticket 23 subsequently renamed the actions themselves (bazarliste -> entrylist, calendrier -> calendar, ...; see docs/action-name-renames.json). The `action` keys below are deliberately NOT updated: an unmigrated page body still spells the action the old way, so this is the spelling the migration will actually encounter. CORRECTED 2026-08-11 (ticket 33): the instruction here used to read 'apply action-name-renames.json first, then this file', which cannot work -- 9 of the 15 actions keyed below are names ticket 23 renames, so renaming the actions first leaves those keys unable to match and their parameters silently un-migrated. Resolve a call's parameters against the action name AS FOUND, then rename the action, in a single pass. ActionCallRewriter does this.

conventions.case: All-lowercase with no separators, matching the existing user-typed parameters these sit beside (template, filtertext, shownumentries, showexportbuttons, nocontainer). camelCase appears in the codebase only on parameters passed programmatically, never on ones a page author types.
conventions.userTyped: true when the name appears in wiki page bodies and a migration must rewrite it. false when the action normalises it internally and no stored content can contain it.
conventions.values: Parameter VALUES are out of scope and unchanged -- template filenames, page tags, field names, and magic keywords such as valeur's texte="lien" or carousel's oui/non.
